clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, sacred ore is on its way to the forge. After you recover elunite from the shipwreck off Auberdine, Elanaria sends you to Mathiel to have it shaped into a weapon for the Kaldorei.

Elanaria sends you across Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace with the elunite ore you recovered from the haunted shipwreck off Auberdine. The warrior trainer packs it in a sturdy case and directs you to Mathiel, one of the capital's finest smiths. He can shape the metal into a weapon worthy of your calling.

Mathiel treats smithing as a craft of devotion. Elunite bears the sacred blessing of Elune, the Moon Goddess, and he accepts the case as an honor. He will shape the holy metal into arms to defend the young boughs of Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have placed the elunite you gathered into a case. Take it to the blacksmith Mathiel, and he will craft for you an elunite weapon.
Mathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, young adventurer. How might my skills serve you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, elunite ore. This is a fine metal to work with, for it is blessed by the goddess Elune herself. It would be an honor to craft weapons with it.
